items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: So we went on down there playing on there. ... Got the booty, Casey Jones. And one or two numbers.

ctx.x: Was he a valve trombone player or a slide? A valve. Valve at that time. Yeah. So we went on down there playing on there.

Well I didn't have many children to play. Got the booty, Casey Jones. And one or two numbers. I could play. The rest I couldn't play. How did you come to get the job? How did they come to hire you? They hired me because he dis-actualy someone I would make the crime for him. So he can't get on me. And I did want to live. Let's see who was an ugly old man for who. Let's see, who's the ugly old man Ford?
Do you have a hood of him? Mm-hmm. Henry Ford, I know.
